hooks.command: if [ -n "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" ]; then printf 'idle\n' >> "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; else friring-cli session signal --state idle >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
if [ -n "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" ]; then printf 'working\n' >> "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; else friring-cli session signal --state working >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
if [ -n "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" ]; then printf 'working\n' >> "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; else friring-cli session signal --state working >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
if [ -n "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" ]; then printf 'done\n' >> "$FRIRING_SIGNAL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; else friring-cli session signal --state done >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
